# KARADAVI

> The Knowledge Forest — structured, connected, evidence-aware knowledge with human editorial authority.

KARADAVI is a knowledge platform and public research project exploring how software can represent connected entities, claims, evidence, provenance, contextual authority, uncertainty, and machine-readable knowledge while preserving human editorial authority.

## Core pipeline

Digital World → Perception → Identification → Semantics → Evidence → Authority → Trust → Machine-readable State

## Public v0.1 model

Entity → Claim → Evidence → Provenance + Authority Context + Uncertainty → Trust Signal → Machine-readable State

## Core principles

Trust should be inspectable. A trust signal should remain connected to the claim, evidence, provenance, authority context, and uncertainty that produced it.

AI may assist extraction and drafting, but publication remains a human editorial decision.

## Public repository

This repository is the public research and architecture surface. It contains conceptual architecture, terminology, design principles, threat modeling, public specifications, schemas, examples, and experiments.

## Product direction

The current private implementation includes a canonical entity engine, ten knowledge domains, structured extraction and drafting, human editorial review, public entity experiences, PWA foundations, and ongoing knowledge-graph work. Private implementation details are intentionally excluded from this repository.

## Private boundary

Private implementation, deployment topology, private datasets, credentials, internal endpoints, and unreleased product work are intentionally excluded.

## Status

Active product development / active research / experimental v0.1 specification. Terminology and schemas may change as experiments are conducted.
